sn35.63:1.2: atha kho āyasmā migajālo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn35.63:1.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā migajālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.63:1.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante ekavihārī hoti? kittāvatā ca pana sadutiya vihārī ca hotīti?
sn35.63:2.1: santi kho migajāla, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.63:2.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.63:2.3: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī,
sn35.63:2.6: nandisaññojana saññutto kho migajāla bhikkhu sadutiya vihārīti vuccati.
sn35.63:2.8: santi kho migajāla jivhāviññeyyā rasā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.63:2.9: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.63:2.10: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī.
sn35.63:2.13: nandisaññojana saññutto kho migajāla bhikkhu sadutiya vihārīti vuccati.
sn35.63:2.14: …pe… santi kho migajāla, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī, nandiyā sati sārāgo hoti, sārāge sati saññogo hoti. nandisaññojanasaññutto kho migajāla, bhikkhu sadutiya vihārīti vuccati. evaṃ vihārī ca migajāla bhikkhu kiñcāpi araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni,
sn35.63:3.1: santi kho migajāla, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.63:3.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.63:3.3: tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandī nirujjhati,
sn35.63:3.6: nandisaññojanavisaññutto kho migajāla, bhikkhu ekavihārīti vuccati. …pe…
sn35.63:3.7: santi ca kho migajāla jivhāviññeyyā rasā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati, nandiyā asati sārāgo na hoti. sārāge asati saññogo na hoti. nandisaññojanavisaññutto kho migajāla bhikkhu ekavihārīti vuccati. …pe…
sn35.63:3.8: santi ca kho migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
sn35.63:3.9: tañce bhikkhu na abhinandati na abhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.63:3.10: tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati,
sn35.63:3.13: nandisaññojana visaññutto kho migajāla bhikkhu ekavihārīti vuccati.
